name: HolyMind — Intent Journey

features.visible_workbench: Three challenges × four existing steps, with source artifacts, a permission/review boundary and a developing output. Source trail is inspectable. Clearly illustrative; no AI/retrieval request, real approval, fabricated client outcome or invented ROI.
features.intent_ownership: Explicit challenge/step input and Carry this skill set the journey. Scroll, section changes and reversing fireworks do not alter choices. Versioned whitelisted IDs/step live only in current-tab sessionStorage, survive reload, and can be cleared. Invalid entries are discarded.
features.connected_destination: Related skills are annotated without filtering the library away. A selected icon travels with the existing carrier where appropriate. Portal icon/heading and reviewable copyable brief reflect the selection. Unchosen visits retain original generic Contact. Copy fallback selects the visible brief; nothing is automatically sent.
features.sound_controls: Each role has an independent switch and an optional attenuating level, default 100% of the approved original mix. Master volume/mute, gesture unlock and lifecycle retained. Legacy cues-off migrates conservatively; changing piano does not turn off fireworks. Harmony-aligned action keys have a separate reaction route, so piano level zero does not silence them.
features.sound_material: All source audio files, score data, note order and accepted long tails unchanged. Real crown x maps to restrained firework stereo pan within ±0.35. No new sound assets or oscillator synthesis. Prior Studio audition modes retained.
features.surface_light: Gold/cyan/violet reflected light on Boom and its echoes derives from the same deterministic particle positions. The brain field lights a narrow source-positioned orbital rim; layers/portal retain directional energy reception. No full-screen flash or changed body copy.
features.render_budget: JS draw cost may select lower Canvas glow DPR only at the next effect boundary. All 259 particle identities, their trajectories, native scrolling and always-on motion remain. No new permanent animation loop; no real-device frame-rate claim.
features.polish: Sound-start hint reflects armed/playing/muted state. Assemble instructions distinguish native scrolling and slider dragging. Footer/version labels aligned.

coverage: Explicit choices, twelve workflow steps, inspect vs carry, tab reload/reset/invalid storage, all 34 skills/filtering, clipboard success/fallback, independent audio gains including piano-zero action signal, responsive widths 320–1440, emulated native touch, stable mobile viewport and exact reversed screen particle coordinates.
preserved: Final recorded burst 3.7 seconds and glitter 4.2 seconds
Mozart melody/order and natural piano release
Electric line sound at +8 dB only during actual visible line travel
Ambient field and fourteen brain reactions
v21 stable viewport / existing Assemble pin
Existing keyboard, menu, dialog and source links

limitations.note: Tests are browser automation/OfflineAudioContext and emulated native touch, not a physical iPhone speaker recording, human listening study or complete accessibility certification. The quality governor observes JS draw cost only.
